title: Persian Gulf
overview: On the eve of her wedding, a bride embarks on a fictional journey that begins in the streets of the city and leads through Iran’s mining landscapes toward the shores of the Persian Gulf. Along the way, the film connects personal experience with the land, its natural resources, and a deeper sense of homeland and identity. Told entirely through visual storytelling and original music, the film unfolds as a dialogue-free cinematic journey from everyday life to the enduring shores of the Persian Gulf.
